auth.tagline: Loyalty that keeps your customers coming back.
auth.description: Stampn turns one-time buyers into regulars with digital stamp cards, automated rewards, and smart campaigns — all from one simple dashboard.
auth.feature1: Digital stamp cards in Apple & Google Wallet
auth.feature2: Track customers, rewards, and campaigns in one place
auth.feature3: Send targeted offers that bring people back
auth.feature4: Launch in minutes — no app for customers to download
